item.title: metacheck: 10 commits today
item.description:
scienceverse/metacheck

Summary unavailable.

10 commit(s) today:

  • 3426bab [repro_not_checkable_580] reproducibility_check: a Python module that exists only on one platform (google.colab, Kaggle, win32com and the like, ehrql) gets the reason platform, and a file of a package run on its own (attempted relative import) the reason how_to_run; both count as not_checkable with advice of their own, instead of a missing package or code written for older package versions (#580, #648; 4 and 8 of 620 medRxiv papers). summary_table gains repro_fail_platform and repro_fail_how_to_run. — Lakens
  • a0a9481 [main] Merge pull request #657 from scienceverse/dev — Daniel Lakens
  • 547aa08 [repro_not_checkable_580] reproducibility_check keeps a script that does not reproduce apart from one it could not check (#580): run_results$checked puts each script in ran, code_error, dependency (a package or program not available), time or not_checkable (a person, the internet, a key, memory, a screen); the report's first sentence, the module summary and summary_table give the groups, and only code_error makes the light red, so a package that was not loaded is now yellow. Calls that need a screen (dev.print(), dev.copy2pdf(), dev.copy2eps(), savePlot(), windows(), x11(), quartz(), View()) are replaced before the run by calls that need none, recorded as screen_call_replaced; a function only R for Windows has gets the reason environment. Version 0.4.4.7 — Lakens
  • 7dda146 [dev] Merge pull request #656 from scienceverse/text_search_limit_645 — Daniel Lakens
  • b436f57 [dev] text_search() keeps its result when the pattern search stops at its step limit on one sentence (#645): that sentence counts as not matching and a warning says how many were not searched; before, one sentence emptied the search of a whole paper list. extract_eq() reads degrees of freedom one character at a time, so a bracket full of numbers no longer reaches the limit: in 18 corpora 42 sentences reached it and now none, 73 rows in 17 papers are added and none lost. Version 0.4.4.6 — Lakens
  • 49c4872 [dev] Merge pull request #655 from scienceverse/p_impossible_351 — Daniel Lakens
  • ebe261b [dev] stat_p_exact lists impossible p-values, below 0 or above 1 (#351): 17 in 14 papers of 18 corpora, each a wrong p-value as written. extract_p_values no longer reads a p that is the subscript of another symbol (r p, alpha p with "=", 2p, Delta p) or a value outside 0-1 with a unit, a logarithm or in a ratio; stat_p_exact gives each p-value its own row; chi-squared is read with a space before its 2; a raised decimal point is read in every paper of a paper list. Version 0.4.4.5 — Lakens
  • 2951a66 [dev] Merge pull request #653 from scienceverse/repro_check_fixes — Daniel Lakens
  • 0589eb8 [dev] R CMD check: the curly quotes and superscript marks in six patterns are written as \u escapes, as portable R code must be ASCII outside comments (r-output.R, reproducibility_check.R) — Lakens
  • 2fe7872 [dev] data_check flags free text only when 1 value in 10 is written in the first person, and not when most values are paths (#648): 473 flagged columns in 22 corpus deposits fell to 44 in 9. Study labels like Shift_E1A and S2_data count when the paper names those studies (#648): files placed in 9 of 77 papers, all correctly. Version 0.4.4.4 — Lakens
  • a31aa31 [dev] A local folder checked without a paper: repo_check counts its naming problems (#650) and codebook_check matches its codebook to its columns (#651, NA paper ids); codebook_check reads a codebook sheet inside a data spreadsheet (#651); the summary says when a run used the recorded R version (#649); data_check: codelists are not card numbers, a person repeated on several rows is flagged once (#648); code is not taken from a knitted .html whose .Rmd is in the deposit (#648) — Lakens
  • 44a339f [dev] repo_check (#648): an unknown file type is not a naming problem; archives and hidden settings files are not listed as unclassified; build files, notices, Stata help files and single compressed files are typed; one address written in two ways is one repository; a preregistration shared with a view-only link is no longer reported as private, and its closed source project is still found. Help pages of earlier packages brought up to date — Lakens
  • 59ba2cb [dev] Line numbers (#648): the ends of the chain must also fit on both sides, and one step of a line may be short (the last line of a paragraph, a heading); keeps "68 of 250 vaccinated" in an abstract and "acquiring 160 contiguous slices", and removes 96 more line numbers — Lakens
  • aefabb2 [dev] A manuscript's line numbers are removed from the text when a paper is read (#648): only in a paper with a sure sign (a run of 5 or more numbers adding one from 30 up, or a chain of stand-alone numbers rising at the pace of a printed line), the runs, the chain and every stand-alone number that fits the line numbers before and after it, across sentences; amounts and table rows stay. The cleaning step is now .paper_repair_text() — Lakens
  • 7d3f168 [dev] Output of the code: knitr::kable() tables (pipe and simple), metafor's marked columns (pval¹) and tval/zval, and lavaan's fit-measure blocks and parameter tables with group lines are read (#648) — Lakens
  • 1b6d5aa [dev] Paper side of the comparison with the output (#648): a raised dot between two digits is a decimal point (The Lancet's "p = 0·0079"), in extract_p_values() and extract_eq(); a significance level is no evidence, and a test of several values none of which is evidence takes no part in match_reported_output() — Lakens
  • 7be781e [dev] Output of the code: the one-line reader takes a statistic's name only as a whole, so code settings (size, width, res, seed) are no longer stored as statistics, and a column of row numbers under a default name (V1 = 1, 2, 3) is not stored (#648) — Lakens
  • 5d933a1 [dev] reproducibility_check: a reported test is found only on values that are evidence of it (#648): match_reported_output(evidence = "informative") counts exact values with 2 significant digits or 3 decimals, a precise test statistic with another value, or a full match; single values only when precise, reported once and matching one output number, others left out of the table and the count; t and z compared without sign; SE only with its estimate; counts are no evidence; new column n_sites — Lakens
  • 22e8a21 [dev] code_check: text that is not a place on the authors' computer is not an absolute path (#648): pieces the code joins to a folder, regular expressions, web routes and queries, devices, keys and data sets inside files, placeholders for the reader's folder, and Windows messages and R regular expressions are left out (.code_is_abs_path()); paths with brackets, {}, * or ? in them stay — Lakens
  • 8413ea2 [dev] code_check and reproducibility_check: files a script of the paper makes are not missing (#648): code_file_refs(writes_only = TRUE) gives the files code writes or downloads, also in Stata, MATLAB and SAS; one list of write calls for code_file_refs() and repro_file_io(); code_check's new column files_written, and a missing file only when no code file of the paper writes it; names with placeholders compared as patterns with enough text of their own; the advice names the script that makes a file under a built name or in another language — Lakens
